title: Caption desk acceptance accounting
description: Weekly count of captions that pass human review across distinct live and correction queues.
content: Count a caption when the desk accepts it. For each independent queue subtract its rejected captions from captions checked. Sum accepted captions across nonoverlapping queues. Ask for identity and overlap rules if a caption can occur twice. Exclude automated delivery and publication.

title: Caption publishing reconciliation
description: Weekly count of accepted captions in a publication pipeline with an automated delivery ledger.
content: For each publishing destination use its successful acceptance receipts. Deduplicate repeated receipts for the same caption and destination. This method requires a publishing ledger; stop short of counting delivery when the request concerns human review.
